lines.en: I break into a run toward you.
I am not large, but I am fast.
I round the stone without slowing.
My steps beat like a drum.

lines.zh: 我压低身子往前扑着走。
lines.en: I keep low and lunge forward.
I crush a tile underfoot.
A single turn and I change direction.
I sprint at full speed, saving nothing.

lines.zh: 我比你矮半截，可追得上。
lines.en: I am half your height, and I can catch you.
I stop, my shoulders still heaving.
I tilt my head and stare at the door.

lines.zh: 我在估算你到墙边的距离。
lines.en: I am judging the distance to the wall.
I say nothing.

lines.zh: 我站在那儿，脚趾抠着地。
lines.en: I stand with my toes dug into the ground.
I wait for you to make one mistake.
My shadow is smaller than I am.
I tilt my head and a joint pops.
I count the bricks in the corridor.
I do not sit, and I do not leave.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候我一直在看。
lines.en: I watch the whole time you speak.
This is a very small room.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把重心移到前脚。
lines.en: I shift my weight onto my front foot.
There is a sound in my throat, faint.
You are taller than me, but slower.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里拿着什么。
lines.en: I see what you are holding.
You meant to go right just now.
Your back is soaked with sweat.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，直勾勾地看你。
lines.en: I look up and stare straight at you.
Your knee is trembling, very slightly.
I have cut your face into memory.
Don't plan on running; I am fast.
Your boots are worn through.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我就不动了。
lines.en: When you look at me, I stop moving.
The moment you look away, I move.
Your breathing is louder than mine.
My legs are the only weapon I need.
You hit me and I twist.
The pain makes me suck in a breath.

lines.zh: 这一下把我逼退了半步。
lines.en: That forced me back half a step.
The mark you left is deep.
I do not stop; I only change angle.

lines.zh: 我的腿软了一下，又绷住。
lines.en: My leg buckles, then locks again.
Good hit, and fast enough.
I breathe out a gust of hot air.
I tilt my head as if I did not understand.
I will return that one.
That little thing in your hand.
Hold it high and I will jump.
I want it, though not urgently.
Throw it and I will fetch it.
I track it with my head.
It matters to you, doesn't it.
I reach out, then pull back.
Holding it slows you down.

lines.zh: 把它放下，我们就平等了。
lines.en: Put it down and we are equals.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，我只要它不在你手里。
lines.en: I do not eat it; I just want it out of your hand.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，反而退得更远。
lines.en: You hit me and end up farther away.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我弹开了。
lines.en: We collide and I bounce off.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，像撞柱子。
lines.en: I hit your leg like a post.
That bump did not stop me.
I am too short to reach your face.
After the bump I take another angle.
You should not have let me get close.
I press against you once and run off.
There is only chase and chased here.
I am a shadow; I cannot make a pair.

lines.zh: 你问的时候，我在算距离。
lines.en: While you asked, I was measuring distance.
I do not take up such talk.

lines.zh: 我只是个缩小版的影子。
lines.en: I am only a shrunken shadow.
I tilt my head, then look away.
Keep that question and run.
I do not answer; I approach.
Ask again and I will act.
This belongs to me now.
I hold it in a tight grip.
I look at it while moving.
It will not stop me chasing you.
I tuck it into the rag at my waist.
It fell and I did not look back.
I drop it behind you.

lines.zh: 拿走你的东西，我不需要。
lines.en: Take your things; I do not need them.
I have your legs fixed.
You cannot run fast; I can tell.
I arch my back, ready to charge.
You are at the end of the corridor, with no door.
This will be quick.

lines.zh: 你的喘声替我数着距离
lines.en: Your panting counts the distance for me.
I chose you; nothing else matters.
My front foot digs in, very quietly.

lines.zh: 从这儿到你这儿，一共七步。
lines.en: Seven steps from here to you.

lines.zh: 你的影子贴在我的脚边。
lines.en: Your shadow lies at my feet.

lines.zh: 你回头，正好看见我起跑。
lines.en: You look back just as I start.
Your lamp swings.
Once I move, all you can do is run.

lines.zh: 这间屋子太小，对你不利。
lines.en: This room is too small for your sake.
I run full speed without turning.
You turn; I cut the inside.
My footfalls come rapidly.
The distance is closing; you can hear it.
You take the stairs; so do I.
I am short, not slow.

lines.zh: 我每步都踩在你踩过的地方。
lines.en: I step where you stepped.
You hold your breath behind the door.
I stop outside the door, just for a moment.
I break the door open.
You run into the yard; perfect.
I am two steps behind you.
You should not have run into the corner.
I sprint the whole corridor without slowing.
I take the shortest path.

lines.zh: 墙在你背后，我在你前面。
lines.en: The wall is behind you; I am in front.
You are nearly out of room.
For the last few steps, I do not slow.
I snatch and catch nothing.
This lands on your knee.

lines.zh: 我撞得你退了，然后跟上去。
lines.en: I knock you back and follow.
My hands are small but quick.

lines.zh: 我扑到你身上，一直不下来。
lines.en: I leap on you and do not let go.
You try to throw me off and cannot.
I drive you toward the wall.

lines.zh: 这一下没多重，可你没退路了。
lines.en: It was not heavy, but you have no room left.
I tear your cuff open.
I lunge and bite down.

lines.zh: 你反击打中我，我歪了一下。
lines.en: You hit me and I twist aside.
I back half a step and charge again.

lines.zh: 你倒地了，我蹲在你旁边。
lines.en: You fall, and I crouch beside you.
I burst out from the far end of the corridor.
At first I am just a low shadow.
My steps arrive before I do.

lines.zh: 我出现时，砖缝里的灰飞起来。
lines.en: When I appear, dust lifts from the joints.
This place is narrower than others; good.
I stand hunched for a moment.
I am shorter than you, but not afraid.
The wind in the room stops.
I take shape little by little.
First a pair of feet, then shoulders.

lines.zh: 我出现时没有任何预兆。
lines.en: I appear without any warning.
You hear something at the door.
I crouch under the doorframe.
I put my head into the room.
I am counting the bricks on the floor.
I walk step by step out of the light.
Someone is in the other room.
I lift my head and look straight over.
This is me, the smaller edition.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我伏低了。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I flatten.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，摔散了。
lines.en: I tumble down the stairs and land badly.
Water floods my mouth and I cough hard.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的肩，我还在跑。
lines.en: An arrow hits my shoulder and I keep running.
That light stiffens me for a moment.

lines.zh: 我越来越轻，跑起来发飘。
lines.en: I grow light and my running goes unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷打在我脚边，我跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes at my feet and I leap.

lines.zh: 我的脚找不到地，一直蹬。
lines.en: My feet find no ground and keep kicking.
